dimension: TRACK A, Use an app (benchmark sections 1 and 2). Stage verdicts for a first-time biologist: (1) CHOOSE an app: app page /apps/nucleisky/ is clear on what the app is and offers OS-detected installer tiles, but says nothing about what input you need or whether an example exists. (2) INSTALL: /guides/install/ is good on the two real blockers (Windows SmartScreen, macOS Open Anyway) but has no prerequisites, no success check and no uninstall. (3) OPEN: /guides/using-apps/ and /guides/notebook-usage/ overlap, never tell the reader to press the play button on the collapsed Welcome cell, and contain wrong or mismatched UI labels. (4) RUN AN EXAMPLE: does not exist anywhere on the path; the reader is told 'Pick one and follow the instructions written in it' and then guesses. (5) FIND/SAVE OUTPUT: not addressed at all; the words save, output, result, export, data, internet, disk, version and tested occur zero times in the four Use-track guides (about 1,260 words in total). (6) NEXT: the Use pager runs install, open and use, notebook usage, troubleshooting, then napari/Fiji/QuPath; no 'work with your own data', 'update' or 'uninstall' task exists. Verdict: there is no 'open example data, run one notebook, find and save the output' walkthrough, so the benchmark's one-sentence test (a scientific outcome, not merely an opened app) fails on this track.
